info.title: Norish Recipe API
info.description: API access for Norish recipes and imports.

get.description: Reports API availability and verifies both the database connection and internal parser service are healthy.

200.description: The API, database, and parser service are healthy.

503.description: The API is up but the database or parser service is unhealthy or unreachable

get.summary: Get a recipe's nutrition per serving
get.description: The recipe's own Nutrition Information, else the total worked out from its ingredients, as the recipe page shows it.

source.description: supplied: the recipe's own Nutrition Information. worked-out: summed from its ingredient lines' dataset numbers for your household, plus the AI's stored share of lines that could not be counted. none: neither gives a number.

calories.description: Calories in kcal per serving; null where the recipe does not say

fat.description: Fat in grams per serving; null where the recipe does not say

carbs.description: Carbohydrates in grams per serving; null where the recipe does not say

protein.description: Protein in grams per serving; null where the recipe does not say

extras.description: Other nutrients per serving, only those known: cholesterol, sodium, potassium, calcium, iron and vitaminC in milligrams, vitaminA in micrograms RAE, the rest in grams. The recipe's own value wins; the others are worked out from its lines.

estimated.description: Whether a worked-out total leans on parent foods for a tenth of its calories or more, or on the AI for a line.

estimatedByAI.description: Whether the AI's share of this line is in the total.

leftOut.description: Lines a worked-out total did not count from the datasets, in recipe order.

credits.description: Datasets a worked-out total took a number from.

extrasCoverage.description: For each extra nutrient, the share (0 to 1) of the counted ingredients by weight whose food knew it; 1 where the recipe states it. Below 1 the value is low by whatever the other ingredients hold.

post.description: Returns a paginated list of recipes. All filter fields are optional, so you can omit them to fetch the default recipe list.

limit.description: Maximum number of recipes to return. Defaults to 50.

searchFields.description: Fields searched when `search` is provided. Defaults to `title` and `ingredients`.

filterMode.description: How multi-value filters are combined. Defaults to `OR`.

sortMode.description: Sort order for the returned recipes. Defaults to `dateDesc`.

maxCookingTime.description: Optional maximum cooking time in minutes.

post.description: Creates a recipe directly from structured recipe data without parser transformation.

post.summary: Queue a recipe import from a URL

409.description: An import of this recipe is already in flight

412.description: The URL is a video and AI or video parsing is not enabled

post.summary: Queue a recipe import from pasted text

text.description:
Pasted recipe text. Supports plain text, JSON-LD recipe objects/arrays/@graph payloads, and YAML recipe mappings/arrays. Each recipe is limited to 100,000 characters. When forcing AI only one recipe will be parsed. JSON-LD single example: {"@type":"Recipe","name":"Toast","recipeIngredient":["2 slices bread"],"recipeInstructions":["Toast bread"]} JSON-LD multi example: [{"@type":"Recipe",...},{"@type":"Recipe",...}] YAML single example: title: Toast
ingredients:
  - 2 slices bread
steps:
  - Toast bread YAML multi example: - title: Toast
  ingredients:
    - 2 slices bread
  steps:
    - Toast bread

recipeIds.description: Created recipe IDs in source order. Single imports still return one ID in this array.

409.description: An import of this recipe is already in flight

delete.description: Send the grocery's current `version` from the list. If it no longer matches, nothing changes and the response has `stale: true`: fetch the list again and retry.

patch.summary: Assign a grocery to a store
patch.description: Send the grocery's current `version` from the list; a stale version changes nothing and returns `stale: true`. A `storeId` of `null` removes the store. With `savePreference` (on by default) the same ingredient goes to this store next time.
